nativeZoom.method: MV3 chrome.tabs.setZoom (browser zoom, not CDP scale or CSS zoom)

contrast.method: Chromium native PNG decoding and exact paired RGBA canvas pixels. Same-layout rendered glyph vs transparent-text backdrop, computed CSS foreground alpha composited at each pixel. >=80% glyph coverage/residual<=10 or near-foreground<=10 RGB; changed midpoint punctuation may use >=30%/residual<=5 because its small glyph has no solid pixel. Thin currentColor SVG control strokes may use >=70%/residual<=2 (actual 16px plus max coverage .777); WCAG control contrast still requires 3:1. Fixed navigation occlusion is excluded at capture, not treated as foreground. Independent Python stdlib PNG implementation cross-check retained.
